nodes.name: Direct Spraying onto β-MnO2 Matrix followed by Air Annealing
nodes.procedure: To enhance both the activity and stability of Ru-doped rutile metal oxide, we chose β-MnO2 as the matrix and synthesized MnRu-based electrocatalysts using direct spraying followed by air annealing. After screening different experimental conditions, we sprayed RuCl3 and MnCl2 precursors in an atomic ratio of 1:3, followed by annealing in air at 400°C for 1 h. Inductively coupled plasma (ICP) measurements revealed that the optimized composition was Mn0.75Ru0.25O2.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP measurements revealed the optimized composition was Mn_{0.75}Ru_{0.25}O_2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Inductively coupled plasma (ICP) measurements revealed that the optimized composition was Mn_{0.75}Ru_{0.25}O_2.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD pattern indicated a rutile structure of the Mn_{0.75}Ru_{0.25}O_2 solid solution, in agreement with Vegard's law.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diffraction (Figure 1b) indicated a rutile structure of the Mn_{0.75}Ru_{0.25}O_2 solid solution, in agreement with Vegard's law.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM elemental mapping showed uniform distribution of elements in Mn_{0.75}Ru_{0.25}O_2; nanostructures exhibited (110) facets with plane spacing of 0.31 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The catalysts had a rough surface and uniform distribution of elements (Figure 1c, Table S2, SEM, Figure S1, TEM, Figures S2, S3, Supporting information). The nanostructures exhibited (110) facets with a plane spacing of 0.31 nm (Figure S3, Supporting information).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru 3p XPS peaks in Mn_{0.75}Ru_{0.25}O_2 shifted 0.4 eV to lower binding energies compared to electrodeposited RuO_2; new XPS peak at 643 eV for Mn sites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) revealed a shift in the Ru 3p peaks in Mn_{0.75}Ru_{0.25}O_2 to lower binding energies (0.4 eV) compared to those of electrodeposited RuO_2 (Figure 1d) ... Further analysis of the electronic structure of the Mn sites showed a new XPS peak at 643 eV (Figure 1g).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru K-edge showed negative shift of 1.3 eV; Mn K-edge showed positive shift of 0.4 eV compared to MnO_2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: a similar negative shift of 1.3 eV in the Ru K-edge using X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS, K space fitting results are shown in Figure S4, Supporting information) (Figure 1e).

nodes.characterization_summary: EXAFS analysis indicated Mn-O bond shortened by 0.04 Å, Ru-O bond elongated by 0.08 Å, and shorter M-OM distance of 2.5-2.7 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) analysis indicated that the Mn-O bond was shortened by 0.04 Å while the Ru-O bond was elongated by 0.08 Å (Figure 1f,i).

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM showed catalysts had a rough surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The catalysts had a rough surface and uniform distribution of elements (Figure 1c, Table S2, SEM, Figure S1, TEM, Figures S2, S3, Supporting information).
